definition_en: The Great Seal; the Kagyu school's highest teaching pointing directly to the nature of mind, emphasizing the inseparability of clarity and emptiness.
definition_zh: 大手印，噶举派最高直指法门，强调心之明空不二，与宁玛派大圆满同指心性本质，路径各异。
notes: Distinguish from Dzogchen (rdzogs chen): both point to the same nature of mind but through different frameworks. Do not conflate.

definition_en: Gampopa Sonam Rinchen (1079–1153); Milarepa's foremost disciple, founder of the Kagyu monastic tradition, author of The Jewel Ornament of Liberation.
definition_zh: 冈波巴·索南仁钦（1079-1153），米拉日巴最重要的弟子，噶举僧团传统的奠基者，著有《解脱庄严宝论》。

definition_en: Jetsun Milarepa (1052–1135); Tibet's most famous yogi and poet, disciple of Marpa Lotsawa, whose life story exemplifies the Kagyu path of devotion and hardship leading to enlightenment in one lifetime.
definition_zh: 杰尊米拉日巴（1052-1135），西藏最著名的瑜伽士与诗人，玛尔巴译师的弟子，其生平示现了噶举虔敬与苦行一生成就的道路。
sources: The Hundred Thousand Songs of Milarepa

definition_en: Marpa Chokyi Lodro (1012–1097); the great translator who founded the Kagyu lineage in Tibet, transmitting teachings from Naropa and Maitripa in India.
definition_zh: 玛尔巴确吉洛卓（1012-1097），在西藏创立噶举传承的大译师，从印度那诺巴与弥底巴处获得传承并带回西藏。
notes: Also the root teacher of Milarepa. 'Lotsawa' (lo tsA ba) means translator — the same word the lotsawa project is named after.

definition_en: Naropa (956–1040); Indian mahasiddha and disciple of Tilopa, teacher of Marpa Lotsawa. Systematized the Six Yogas of Naropa.
definition_zh: 那诺巴（956-1040），印度大成就者，帝洛巴的弟子，玛尔巴的上师，系统整理了那诺巴六瑜伽。

definition_en: Six advanced Vajrayana practices transmitted by Naropa: inner heat (tummo), illusory body, dream yoga, clear light, consciousness transference (phowa), and bardo yoga.
definition_zh: 那诺巴传授的六种高级金刚乘修法：拙火（图摩）、幻身、梦瑜伽、光明、颇瓦（迁识）、中阴瑜伽。
sources: Six Yogas of Naropa by Tsongkhapa
notes: Phowa (pho ba) is shared with Nyingma; the other five yogas are primarily Kagyu/Gelug practices.

definition_en: Inner heat; the first of the Six Yogas of Naropa. A practice generating blissful warmth through visualization and breathwork, used as a foundation for higher tantric realizations.
definition_zh: 拙火，那诺巴六瑜伽之首，通过观想与气息修炼生起内热，作为更高密续证悟的基础。

definition_en: The intermediate state between death and rebirth; Vajrayana teachings identify multiple bardos including the bardo of dying, dharmata, and becoming.
definition_zh: 死亡与再生之间的中间状态；金刚乘教法细分为临终中阴、法性中阴与转世中阴。
sources: Bardo Thodol (Tibetan Book of the Dead)
notes: The Bardo Thodol (bar do thos grol) is a Nyingma terma attributed to Padmasambhava, revealed by Karma Lingpa.

definition_en: The head of the Karma Kagyu school; one of the earliest tulku (reincarnate lama) lineages in Tibet, currently in its 17th incarnation.
definition_zh: 噶玛噶举派的领袖，西藏最早的祖古（转世喇嘛）传承之一，目前为第十七世。
notes: There is a recognized dispute over the 17th Karmapa between two candidates; avoid taking sides in translation or commentary.

definition_en: A recognized reincarnation of a previous lama; also one of the three kayas (bodies) of a Buddha — the nirmanakaya or emanation body.
definition_zh: 经认定的前世喇嘛转世；同时也是佛的三身之一——化身（nirmanakaya），即应化身。
notes: Context-sensitive: in institutional contexts means reincarnate lama; in philosophical contexts means nirmanakaya. Distinguish clearly.

definition_en: The three bodies of a Buddha: dharmakaya (truth body), sambhogakaya (enjoyment body), and nirmanakaya (emanation body).
definition_zh: 佛的三种身：法身（dharmakaya）、报身（sambhogakaya）与化身（nirmanakaya）。

definition_en: The truth body of a Buddha; the absolute, formless dimension of enlightenment, identified in Dzogchen with rigpa and in Mahamudra with the nature of mind.
definition_zh: 佛的法身，证悟的绝对无形次元；在大圆满中与本觉（rigpa）等同，在大手印中与心之本性等同。
